name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for engineering, sparked by rebuilding old mopeds with his grandfather in rural Portugal. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, quickly gravitating towards simulation technology. His first role was at a small firm specializing in flight simulators, but his true passion remained with racing. An opportunity arose at a local karting team, where he built a rudimentary simulator that significantly improved driver performance. 

He joined Carlin five years ago, bringing a wealth of practical experience and a meticulous approach to simulator development. Ricardo focuses on creating realistic scenarios that push drivers to their limits, constantly refining the software and hardware to mirror real-world conditions. His dedication and ability to troubleshoot complex issues make him a valuable asset to the team. He is known for his calm demeanor and dedication to the team.

physical.description: Ricardo is of medium build with a slight stoop from years spent hunched over computers.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with equations and observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking his espresso black, no sugar, no exceptions.
